questions.question: What is the difference between ++$x and $x++ in PHP?
questions.solution_html:
• ++$x: Pre-increment → increment then use
  • $x++: Post-increment → use then increment
  • Example: $x=5; echo ++$x; //6, echo $x++; //5

questions.question: State the difference between echo and print with example.
questions.solution_html:
• echo: Language construct, faster, multiple params, no return.
  • print: Function, returns 1, single argument.
  • Example

  • print "A"."B"; → AB Differences (3 marks), Example (2 marks)
